thread:
Marta G: Quick sync — NVIDIA just flagged a potential H200 board shortage that may push GA into late May. We need to coordinate marketplace listing waves + joint PR windows. Can we confirm fallbacks (H100 / MI300 / B200 / Gaudi) and which customers should be routed to Dedicated vs Hosted? Ping @Jordan @Priya for SI integration & announce timing. Agenda: 1) alternative model pinning 2) embargo/announce windows 3) marketplace calendar updates 4) draft joint comms. Vendor note: https://vendor-notes.internal/nvidia-h200-availability (redacted)

Jordan L: Saw the vendor note. On infra side we can swap routing to H100/Gaudi artifacts but need to validate quant profiles + perf delta. I can run a small perf matrix this week. Also need to confirm capacity in our US-west cluster for burst.

Priya S: For SI integrations — recommend we do a soft beta with 3 SIs first. If H200 GA slips to late May, propose: beta wave May 20 (invite-only), GA wave May 30. That avoids colliding with the cloud partner announce on June 2. Who will own customer comms for the beta? :thinking_face:

Ken T: Product can own the customer comms. I'll draft a short customer note + FAQ. Suggest embargo window = 48 hours before public page goes live. Also need to decide marketplace listing strategy: staggered regions or global cutover? Staggered reduces blast risk.

Marta G: Good points. Jordan — can you post perf numbers by Tue EOD? Priya — can you share the SI shortlist and their preferred validation stacks? Ken — draft comms and I'll iterate. I'll also open a tiny doc for embargo wording and share to #marketing once draft exists.

nvidia-biz-bot: Automated update: NVIDIA update posted 2026-04-14 09:12 UTC — H200 expected lead times fluctuating; recommended to plan fallback variants. Link: https://vendor-notes.internal/nvidia-h200-2026-04-14

Jordan L: Quick config snippet I'll use to test routing (for infra):
```
# testing routing override
routing.policy = "region:first,capacity:fallback"
aliases = ["redwood-h100-v1","redwood-gaudi-v2","redwood-mi300-q8"]
# run perf suite
./scripts/run_perf.sh --models ${aliases} --seq 2048 --concurrency 16
```

Priya S: SI shortlist attached to the calendar invite I just created: https://calendar.internal/event/cc-1234 — includes windows they can test (May 18-22). I'll email each SI with the draft test plan after Jordan posts perf numbers.

Ken T: Draft comms layout (first pass):
- subject: Important update: GPU availability & how we’re protecting your workloads
- lead: short paragraph about H200 supplier variability
- bullets: what we’re doing (routing fallbacks, dedicated reservations, support)
- actions for customers (pin model, request Dedicated, contact SE)
Will share in channel later today.

Marta G: Action items recap: Jordan -> perf matrix by Tue EOD (1798967634). Priya -> SI shortlist + test windows (calendar created). Ken -> first draft comms by EOD. I'll coordinate embargo wording and sync with marketing/legal. If anyone sees a downstream customer window that conflicts with May 20-30, flag it here. :white_check_mark:

Jordan L: Noted. I'll start perf runs now and post results as soon as they finish.

Priya S: On it — will also loop in Solutions Eng to prep validation harnesses.

Ken T: I'll drop the comms draft in #marketing in ~3 hours. If legal needs to edit, please do inline edits.

Marta G: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for the announce cadence. We'll decide final embargo by Thu. :calendar:
